title: clio-coder run event line (schema v2)
description: One line of `run --output-format stream-json`: NDJSON, one compact object per line, each with a `type`. The first line is `session` for a main run, `steer` acknowledges a steer-channel line, and the last line is always `run_end` (schema run-result). Agent event frames between them keep their engine shape and are open objects.

line.description: 1-based line index in the steer channel.

runEnd.description: The closing document; its full shape is `clio-coder schema run-result`.
